name: Tamaki (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tamaki town emblem in white: a stylised device of two curved horns enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Tamaki, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 6 May 1965.

features.role: Tamaki town emblem — a stylised device of two curved horns enclosing a stylised character
